Plant: Backyard tomato
Recorded: 2026-10-21
Status: at_risk
Health score: 50 (0-100), band At risk — will worsen without action
Confidence: medium - Yellowing leaves and brown spots on older leaves suggest stress, but the new top growth being green indicates some recovery.

Note: this is an earlier AI assessment with the stated confidence, not a diagnosis.
